title: Digital purchase receipt
description: Send a digital receipt after an in-store purchase with the total and a link to the full invoice. Payment confirmation template for retail.
notes: Only send it to customers who gave their number at checkout and agreed to receive receipts. Keep marketing out of it.

body.text: Thanks for shopping at {{store_name}}, {{first_name}}. We received your payment of {{amount}} on {{date}}. Your receipt is ready below.
